Author: monkdim
Name: Maple's Echo
Description: Displays a Discord channel's live voice-to-text callouts inside FFXIV, in a dedicated, fully customizable accessibility window. One-way relay (Discord to game). This repo is configured for one specific setup — fork it and run your own copy. See the README.
Punchline: An in-game accessibility window for Discord voice-to-text callouts.
